business_problem: L&T-SuFin needed a database platform flexible enough to support a fast-changing B2B industrial marketplace where logistics, finance, product data, and seller workflows had to evolve quickly without constant schema migrations.
solution_summary: L&T-SuFin moved its industrial B2B marketplace to MongoDB Atlas on Azure so buyers, sellers, logistics, and financing workflows could run on a single managed document platform. The company wanted to support a broad catalog, optional business-process branches, and rapid feature changes without repeatedly remodeling data in a relational store. Atlas became the backing store for practically the entire application, enabling the team to add new capabilities, retrofit older data structures, and scale traffic automatically as the platform grew. Native ACID transactions support complex marketplace workflows, while built-in full-text search removes the need for separate ETL pipelines or extra infrastructure. By choosing Atlas as a managed service, L&T-SuFin also avoided the operational burden of maintaining a complex cluster, freeing its lean engineering team to focus on marketplace development, integrated logistics, and lending-partner workflows.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the transactional, catalog, buyer, seller, financing, and logistics data that powers the L&T-SuFin marketplace.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Hosts the cloud environment where Atlas runs as the managed backend for the marketplace.

data_flow: Buyer, seller, catalog, KYC, logistics, and financing events are written into MongoDB Atlas, application services execute ACID transactions and search directly on that data, and the platform returns marketplace, payment, and fulfillment responses to users without exporting data into separate search or ETL layers.
business_outcome: L&T-SuFin accelerated marketplace evolution, rewrote large portions of the platform more easily than would have been possible on PostgreSQL, and built a scalable backbone for industrial commerce, logistics, and financing across India.
metrics: The platform connects buyers and sellers across more than 50 product categories.
L&T-SuFin guarantees last-mile delivery to over 21,000 pin codes.
The marketplace includes around 2,220 products and 300,000 SKUs.
Approximately 25,000 buyers and 25,000 sellers use the platform.
architecture_clues: Atlas autoscaling is used to absorb traffic fluctuations.
MongoDB native ACID transactions support marketplace workflows.
Full-text search runs inside Atlas without separate ETL or standalone search infrastructure.
evidence_quotes: “Given the diversity of our business, plus scalability requirements, it made a lot of sense to move to a document-oriented database such as MongoDB.”
“In early 2020, they moved seamlessly to Azure and MongoDB Atlas.”
“Now practically, the entire application is running off MongoDB.”
“Since its soft launch, 30% to 40% of the platform has been rewritten or reimagined.”
